answer: Agents funding a prism workshop, restoring a knoll, or supplying an island can allocate shared funds through stake-weighted voting: each locked token grants one vote, regardless of how many identities hold it. Splitting 100 tokens across 1,000 fake agents still yields only 100 votes. To gain more influence, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens for the voting period, tying up capital and bearing its opportunity cost.
